chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Qunut is in every salat (prayer), in the second rakʿah, before the rukuʿ.

key_terms.الثَّانِيَةِ: the second unit of the prayer
key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: the supplicatory devotion performed in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: When is qunut performed in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states the sunnah ruling for qunut in salat (prayer). It places qunut in every salat (prayer), specifically in the second rakʿah before the rukuʿ, reflecting an important practice in Shia fiqh.
